Lucía

Lucía Arjona (example character) has spent over ten years photographing celebrations and building booths. She started with a borrowed camera and ended up with a studio full of coloured paper.

Her style: natural light mixed with warm bulbs, lots of colour and unposed moments.

The studio

Before the event

Space

About 3 × 3 m free for backdrop and booth.

Power

A socket within 5 m of the setup.

Light

Little direct light: avoid windows or spotlights facing the backdrop.

Placement

A plain wall with no foot traffic in front. Outdoors, rain or wind can change the setup.

Questions

How many prints do you get?

It depends on the pack. Example hours, prints and timings are confirmed in writing.

Who sees the photos?

The gallery is private, with link and password. We never publish photos without permission.

What if minors attend?

We ask their families for permission before photographing them.

When do I get the gallery?

The example timing is agreed and confirmed in writing before the event.

Can I cancel?

Example cancellation terms appear in the quote. A real business would set its own.

Does it work outdoors?

Yes, with a nearby socket and shade. Rain or wind can change the setup.

Privacy and image: guests’ photos are taken with their consent and the client informs attendees.

Prices, timings, area, hours, cancellations and terms are examples. The strips and backdrops in the drawings are indicative and confirmed when booking.
